decisions.statement: Use REST/JSON and OpenAPI with the frozen errors, session/mutation protection, bounded keyset paging and command headers. Upstream Shop/Admin GraphQL queries/mutations and union error results inform responsibilities only; no schema, endpoint or API parity. X1 is separate.

Use existing Jeeves durable authenticated sessions; no anonymous checkout in the core. Trusted application/shop scope is established server-side. A Vendure channel token or order code is not tenant/owner authority. Recheck scope, current membership and field policy for all detail/list/history/byte/callback/worker paths.

Core uses USD safe-integer minor units, positive integer quantities <=1000, <=100 lines, checked overflow before arithmetic, immutable quote inputs and explicit flat shipping/fixture tax. Configurable upstream rounding does not establish these bounds or production tax behavior.

Domain writes, canonical-input command receipt, expected aggregate version, audit and durable event intent share a PostgreSQL transaction. Same scoped principal/operation/key/input replays the authorized result; changed input conflicts. No lost-response or stale-version guarantee is inferred from @Transaction or ordinary saves.

Jeeves separates active cart from converted immutable order. Checkout checks current quote/version and atomically snapshots line/address/price plus reservations and receipt. Upstream uses an Order across AddingItems/payment and can recalculate prices/currency; it does not define this conversion protocol.

Reserve at checkout in a single-location authority transaction with ordered locking/CAS and nonnegative availability. Active/held-for-payment/consumed/released/expired states are explicit. Expire active reservations once with fenced worker claims; start-payment races choose one state. Hold stock for unknown payment until a deliberate reconciliation/cancellation decision, unlike assuming allocation at payment implies earlier reservation.

External I/O runs outside local SQL transactions using a durable attempt identity. accepted-but-timeout is unknown/payment-review with stock held, never automatic failure/success. Verify raw callback bytes/provider identity/amount/scope; deduplicate events and prevent older failure from undoing settlement. V08 proves the local reference protocol only; V19 requires an independently verified concrete adapter.

Serialize aggregate updates and sum all noncancelled shipment quantities per line; require paid, reserved and remaining quantities before shipment. One command identity returns one shipment. Handler calls/read-before-write checks alone do not prove this concurrent ceiling or provider deduplication.

Published catalog/public assets and customer/staff order projections use authoritative scope/visibility before details, snippets, counts and bytes. Stable bounded keyset reads replace upstream offset search; rebuilds cannot resurrect hidden records. No complete upstream asset/download or callback audit was performed.

Persist atomic outbox intent and per-recipient internal-effect receipts, then recheck access/preferences before sensitive materialization/delivery. Use finite retries, scheduled due time, leased/fenced claims, visible exhaustion/reconciliation and restart recovery. In-memory commit-aware subscribers and graceful job deferral do not establish crash-safe publication, hard-kill recovery or exactly-once external effects. SQL job insertion can use the supplied transaction context; the inspected email publication does not pass it.

decisions.input: immutable cart/quote, eligible promotion set, currency, limits and policy version
decisions.result: pure bounded allocated adjustments and reasons or rejection; deterministic exact rounding and invariant totals
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject ineligible codes/excessive allocations; same inputs recalculate without accumulating adjustments. No direct writes.
decisions.remainingDecision: eligibility/exclusion ordering, stacking/caps, minor-unit remainder tie-break and exact repeated-allocation fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: authorized address/jurisdiction, immutable items/currency, request identity and adapter/policy version
decisions.result: typed amount quote, provider/provenance/version and expiry or explicit unavailable
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject forged override, stale quote and currency mismatch; timeout/unavailable never invents tax or commits checkout. Stable request identity for retries.
decisions.remainingDecision: named production tax adapter contract, authority/expiry, timeout budget, quote values and independent provider failure fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: authorized package/address/cart snapshot, currency, request identity and strategy version
decisions.result: bounded eligible carrier/service quotes with amounts, expiry and provenance
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject untrusted price/service override and expired quote; unavailable carrier cannot complete checkout. Repeated selection uses stable quote identity.
decisions.remainingDecision: package bounds, supported carrier/service strategy, rate expiry, unavailable/cancellation behavior and independent quote fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: authorized paid/fulfilled/already-refunded snapshot, quantities/amounts, reason, expected version and refund request identity
decisions.result: allowed quantities/amounts and next command or rejection; effectful provider step explicitly separate
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Enforce cumulative quantity/amount ceilings and foreign-order denial. Duplicate refund reuses a durable identity; uncertain provider result stays in reconciliation without a second refund.
decisions.remainingDecision: return eligibility/window and restock policy, refund allocation/shipping/tax, provider unknown/reconcile statuses and exact partial/duplicate fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: authorized seller attribution, settlement window, immutable order/payment references, fee policy version and settlement identity
decisions.result: bounded seller entitlement/settlement plan distinct from customer charge; no direct cross-seller ledger writes
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject foreign seller scope; repeated/interrupted execution preserves entitlements and queues inspectable reconciliation, never duplicate payout.
decisions.remainingDecision: seller membership/attribution, fee rounding, settlement timing/payout adapter, refund/chargeback treatment and recovery fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: original exact amounts/currency, requested currency, immutable rate/source/time/version snapshot and rounding policy
decisions.result: pure rounded converted quote and provenance, never a rewrite of a completed order
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject unsupported currency or invalid/stale rates; unavailable rates explicit. Same snapshot repeats deterministically without converting a completed amount twice.
decisions.remainingDecision: currency allowlist, rate authority/expiry, rational conversion/remainder rounding, bounds and immutable completed-order fixtures
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: durable provider request identity and typed amount/currency; original callback bytes, signature metadata and configured credential reference separately
decisions.result: settled/failed/pending/unknown with provider references or an authenticated typed event
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Verify signature, amount/status, provider and scope before effects; stable provider idempotency and event receipts survive duplicates/reordering/timeouts. Unknown requires reconciliation.
decisions.remainingDecision: named real provider and pinned protocol fixture, signature/replay window, status and idempotency mappings, timeout/reconciliation mechanism; local V08 fixture cannot satisfy this row
decisions.defaultUnavailable: HTTP 503, no domain changes and no success until the hook is implemented.

decisions.input: verified source event/revision, external stock identity, mapping/authority version and local reservation snapshot
decisions.result: validated local stock command or explicit reconciliation item with stable external identity
decisions.rejectionAndRecovery: Reject unauthenticated/foreign source; deduplicate/out-of-order revisions, preserve held stock and never overwrite authority silently. Interruption resumes receipt/reconciliation without double adjustment.
decisions.remainingDecision: named ERP/source contract, absolute-versus-delta semantics, revision ordering/tombstones, reservation conflict authority and recovery fixtures

rows.adaptation: Existing Jeeves authenticated sessions/role separation and restart-safe revocation replace upstream anonymous-owner sessions and configurable auth shortcuts. The guard is context, not a complete credential/session protocol audit.

Keep enabled product inspiration while specifying bounded queries and authoritative product/variant/asset publication on all reads and delayed projections. Asset-byte/publication-command internals were not audited.

Upstream sequences taxes/promotions/shipping and delegates rounding; it does not establish checked safe-integer arithmetic, immutable inputs, fixed USD fixture bounds or overflow rejection. Implement and verify those independently.

Cart add/change/remove use server-authoritative prices and finite line/quantity limits. Add atomic expectedVersion and scoped canonical replay receipts; upstream partial quantity correction/error results are not the frozen all-or-conflict protocol.

Convert cart to one immutable line/address/price snapshot plus reservations in one transaction. Upstream creates an Order before payment and recalculates prices; no same-key checkout or failure-injection atomicity is inferred.

Default upstream allocation occurs after payment authorization/settlement, not a benchmark checkout reservation with expiry. Prove last-item locking, held-payment protection and expiration/start-payment restart race independently; read/update stock excerpts do not establish no-oversell.

Adopt explicit transition/guard responsibility but freeze the smaller benchmark state graph with expected versions. Payment state/fulfillment cannot be forged; repeated/stale commands and cancellation recheck guards and change no contradictory terminal state.

Use a durable reference-provider protocol and authenticated raw-byte callbacks with event receipts. The handler is awaited before payment persistence; this does not supply unknown outcome/reconciliation or cross-network atomicity. Hold stock and prevent stale failure from reversing settlement.

Jeeves must sum every active shipment and serialize competing changes under paid/reserved ceilings. The inspected upstream helper finds a matching fulfillment line; this is not a cumulative concurrent-ceiling proof or a shipment retry receipt.

Use published-only scoped public projections and stable bounded keyset pages. Upstream has offset/limit, a deterministic variant-ID tie-break and queued rebuilds; optional enabled filtering and projections alone do not establish immediate hiding or private-field exclusion.

Unify customer ownership/scoped staff policy across direct IDs, list/count/history, downloads and callbacks. Owner comparisons and staff permissions are inspected; order-code strategy, download bytes, full history and provider routes are not audited or inherited.

Keep attributed transition audit and eligible notifications atomic/durable in Jeeves. Upstream has history calls, commit-aware in-memory events and queued email with five requested retries; none establishes crash-safe materialization, current redaction or internal deduplication.
Calculator reset/reapplication informs the seam, not promotion eligibility/stacking/remainder policy. No upstream promotion algorithm was audited; H remains a pure explicit project hook.
Tax-zone and configured tax-line calculation are context only. A production tax provider with immutable provenance/expiry/unavailable behavior is a separate hook; fixture tax does not earn V14.

Configured shipping calculation informs the responsibility. Carrier/rate/package strategy, trusted quote identity/expiry and unavailable-provider decisions remain explicit; flat fixture shipping does not supply them.

Upstream refund amount constraints are context; return eligibility, cumulative quantities, stable refund identities and ambiguous provider recovery remain project policy. No complete upstream returns/refund concurrency audit.

Seller-order splitting is visible as a call, not an inspected marketplace settlement engine. Attribution/access/fees/payout reconciliation remain project policy; do not infer missing or separately licensed upstream functionality.

Upstream can recalculate order currency from context; this is not snapshotted conversion. Jeeves never reinterprets completed money; rate provenance, exact conversion/rounding and unavailability remain a separate hook.
Generic provider methods inform adapter separation only. No concrete provider signature/idempotency/reconciliation implementation was inspected; V08 reference-protocol evidence cannot satisfy V19.

Stock adjustment context is not an inspected ERP connector. Source authentication/revision ordering/absolute-versus-delta authority, conflicts with reservations and recoverable receipts remain explicit project policy.

limitations: Static inspection of listed ranges, not an exhaustive security/concurrency audit or executed upstream test. Unread callers, strategies and adapters may have additional behavior.
GraphQL upstream responsibility is deliberately adapted to REST/JSON/OpenAPI, not API parity. No upstream runtime or code copied into Jeeves.
No runtime/template availability, passing benchmark observations, implementation coverage or measured capacity is supplied.
Frozen P59 manifest/requirements/integrity and P60a source map are unchanged; this sidecar records provenance without changing acceptance.
Existing six source catalog entries and their pins are preserved. P60c owns Zammad and the combined P60 reference review.
